motds.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.
motds.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!

motds.body: Swing into action with Batman’s Grapnel Gun and Batarang as Gotham City lands in OG.
motds.title: Welcome to Gotham City!

motds.body: Gifting the Override Battle Pass unlocks the Peril Peak Mali Style and matching accessories for both the gifter and the friend receiving it!
motds.tabTitle: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style
motds.title: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style

motds.body: Take up Sora's iconic Kingdom Key and fight your way to victory like a true hero of light!
motds.title: Wield the Kingdom Key

motds.body: Stay connected anywhere! Party up and voice chat with friends across Fortnite, the Epic Games Launcher, and the Epic Games mobile app. Move voice chat between devices, background the app and keep chatting on the go, and automatically land in the same Fortnite Lobby when friends accept your invite.
motds.title: The Party Never Ends
